metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Core defines the foundational capability that establishes what it means for a device to be recognized as an institutional endpoint. It defines execution environment boundaries, ownership expectations, and baseline trust assumptions independently of configuration hardening, health, or threat state.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint recognition and execution environment legitimacy. Controls are scoped to endpoint sub‑capabilities to enable precise assessment of baseline endpoint trust.
